sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Acemetacin is not marketed in the United States, but is available in other countries. No information is available on the clinical use of acemetacin during breastfeeding; however, acemetacin is a pro-drug of indomethacin, so the information on indomethacin probably applies equally to acemetacin. If a mother requires acemetacin, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding; however, an alternate drug may be preferred, especially while nursing a newborn or preterm infant.
